worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = private pension (person 0) 20,000.00 + long-term gains 30,000.00 = 50,000.00. Federal taxable income = 50,000.00 - standard deduction 17,750.00 (15,750.00 + 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older) = 32,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored, although Montana's line 2 would take it). Filing status single, no Montana standard deduction or exemptions. Schedule I Part I: line 7 additions 0.00; line 24 subtractions 0.00. Form 2 page 1: line 1 federal AGI 50,000.00; line 2 Form 1040 lines 12e and 13b 17,750.00; line 3 32,250.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 0.00; line 6 age 65 subtraction 1 x 5,660.00 = 5,660.00; line 7 Montana taxable income 32,250.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 - 5,660.00 = 26,590.00. Page 2 worksheet: line 1 26,590.00; line 2 net long-term gains 30,000.00; line 3 lesser 26,590.00; line 4 ordinary income 26,590.00 - 26,590.00 = 0.00; line 5 21,100.00; line 6 21,100.00 - 0.00 = 21,100.00; line 7 lesser of lines 3 and 6 = 21,100.00; line 8 3% x 21,100.00 = 633.00; line 9 26,590.00 - 21,100.00 = 5,490.00; line 10 4.1% x 5,490.00 = 225.09; line 11 633.00 + 225.09 = 858.09; line 12 ordinary income tax on 0.00: 4.7% x 0.00 = 0.00; line 13 858.09 + 0.00 = 858.09, carried to page 1 line 8. Bracket schedule as numbers (the expected figure): 4.7% x 21,100.00 = 991.70; 5.9% x (26,590.00 - 21,100.00 = 5,490.00) = 323.91; bracket tax 1,315.61. Gains limited to taxable income: lesser of 30,000.00 and 26,590.00 = 26,590.00; extra rate -1.8% x 26,590.00 = -478.62; 1,315.61 - 478.62 = 836.99. Line 9 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 10 tax after credits 836.99. The form gives 858.09; expected keeps the projection's 836.99, a difference of 21.10 from 3% against 2.9% on the 21,100.00 of gains inside the first bracket, 21.10. Taxable income 26,590.00 is less than the gains, so line 3 limits them and ordinary income on the worksheet is 0.00, though the household had a 20,000.00 pension.
accepted_approximations: Montana taxes long-term gains at two rates, and the format holds one extra rate. Gains run through the ordinary brackets on top of ordinary income and pay an extra rate of -0.018 (4.1% less 5.9%). That is exact for gains above the first bracket, and gives 2.9% where the booklet says 3% for gains inside it. The gains must be limited to taxable income first (Form 2 page 2 line 3).
